run_acute_eval_crowdsourcing_task: run the ACUTE-Eval crowdsourcing task on MTurk using the run.py script with a pairings file
configure_scriptconfig_for_acute_eval: configure the ScriptConfig dataclass to set monitoring_log_rate and task_dir for ACUTE-Eval
register_scriptconfig_with_mephisto: register the ScriptConfig module with Mephisto using register_script_config for Hydra integration
run_main_with_hydra_config: run the main function with a Hydra DictConfig to launch and monitor an ACUTE-Eval HIT
load_db_and_process_config: load the Mephisto database and process the Hydra config using load_db_and_process_config
